goal_metric: median minutes from red docs CI to green
effect_probe: after each merged fix, re-read the workflow's last-run conclusion; put conclusion_before/after in the next receipt's effects
finisher: docs CI green again, or the failure triaged as infra and escalated to the platform queue
stop_rule: 14 days with no accepted fix and no measured improvement -> pause and ask the owner to retire the loop
cron: example: the scheduler that fires this every 30 minutes
notes: Generic adoptable example. Copy, rename, point ledger at your durable state, then wrap your existing tick: loop tick this.json -- /path/to/existing-tick.sh
